data.message: Fisher01–25: I commit to 18 tons this month; join individually, not all-or-nothing. Versus 10, 18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, then500 or100—not risk-free or proven best long-term. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each of the other24: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others. You may opt for18 even if others choose10.
